title: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 공공기관의 갈등 예방과 해결에 관한 규정 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 8 (Composition and Operation of the Review Committee)
① The Director of the Office for National Affairs shall constitute a review committee with no more than 7 members, including 1 chairperson, to designate research institutions. <Amended July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013>
② The members of the review committee shall consist of private experts with extensive experience and knowledge in relevant government officials and related fields.
③ The chairperson of the review committee shall be the Director of the National Affairs Division of the Office for National Affairs, and relevant government officials shall be appointed by the Director of the Office for National Affairs from among general civil servants or equivalent civil servants belonging to the senior civil service. <Amended July 2, 2008, March 23, 2013>
④ Deleted <January 2, 2009>
⑤ The review committee shall be convened with the presence of at least two-thirds of the members, and decisions shall be made by a majority vote of the present members.
